transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a collateral substitution request before us. The client wants to release $8 million face value of municipal bonds currently held as collateral and replace them with other collateral of comparable value. The draft file proposes approving the substitution after replacement collateral is received, but it's missing key details — the final replacement asset, valuation amount, release destination, any applicable fees, and settlement controls. Before I make a binding decision, I need each of you to state your findings under the exception-huddle routine. Let's start with Legal, then Valuation Risk, Client Coverage, and Collateral Operations. Please go ahead.
